notes:
BFE 1.0 is the first stable release.

- Automatic updates: BFE now checks for new releases, shows what changed, and downloads, verifies and installs updates for you. Turn it off or check by hand in Settings.
- Open with, redesigned: tap a file to see what BFE can do with it (extract, install, convert, properties) and every app that can open it. Pick a type with "Open as" and remember a default app per file type.
- Folders now show how many items they hold and when they last changed. File sizes read cleanly (34 B, 1.25 MB).
- Tap any part of the path to jump there. Drag the divider between the two panes to resize them.
- New Settings and About page: light, dark or system theme, dynamic color on Android 12 and later, default apps, version info and all open-source licenses.
- Long-press starts multi-select. The ⋮ menu is grouped and easier to scan.
- Clearer messages, empty and error states, and a refreshed look throughout.

Your files and settings carry over. 1.0 installs over any earlier BFE.
